name: NHS & respiratory
summary: UKHSA 19 Nov: flu admissions up to 4.68 per 100,000, still low but rising; RSV rising; COVID-19 stable
state: UKHSA's update of 19 Nov, covering 9–15 Nov, put influenza hospital admissions at 4.68 per 100,000, up from 3.76, with positivity up to 11.4% from 8.3% and flu still circulating at low levels (UKHSA). RSV admissions rose to 1.66 per 100,000 and COVID-19 was stable at 2.22. Flu is above baseline and rising but not at high levels, and no widespread NHS critical incidents were found, so Watch is kept.
for_you: Older people, young children, pregnant women and those with long-term conditions are most at risk; the NHS advises eligible groups to get flu and RSV vaccines. Use NHS 111 for non-emergency advice.
rubric_hit: Watch: flu activity above baseline and rising (admissions 4.68 per 100,000, positivity 11.4%); not high nationally
